description: Save what the person told you about the brand, short and in their words. Send only the fields that change; an empty string, empty list or null clears one. Pass account_id to save a voice for that account only; the rest read the workspace voice. Update it when they correct your tone. Every draft in this workspace, by anyone, follows it. Undo restores the version before.

about.description: What the account is about, e.g. "Anesthesia residency, case logging and study tips"

audience.description: Who it's for, e.g. "CRNA students and new residents"

avoid.description: Words, topics or habits to stay away from

avoid_words.description: Words and phrases drafts must not use; draft_check flags each hit

emoji.description: none, some (3 or fewer), lots, or short text such as "only a stethoscope"

examples.description: Up to 5 captions that sound like the brand

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

sounds_like.description: How posts sound: tone, words they use, a creator or post to sound like

tone.description: How the brand sounds, e.g. ["warm", "dry humor"]; a list of short words, or null to clear

use_words.description: Words and phrases drafts should use

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: voice_set
title: Save how the brand sounds
